title: Vladimir GUERRERO JR. 2022 TOPPS SERIES 1 STARS OF MLB FOIL #SMLB-22 BLUE JAYS
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2022 Topps Series 1 sports trading card features Vladimir Guerrero Jr. of the Toronto Blue Jays. The card is an insert in the set and has a blue parallel/variety. It is a star card, with the card number SMLB-22, and is part of the Major League Baseball (MLB) league. The card is not autographed and is perfect for collectors who are fans of the sport.
